BEYOND YOUR FIRST YEAR
For the best combination of location, pricing, and connecting to the UVA community, on-Grounds housing can’t be beat. Living on Grounds eliminates the stress and pressure that can come when making a housing decision. Our student-focused process for returning undergraduates allows you to focus on what's most important right now - your academics - knowing that you have the option to live on-Grounds with your friends.

Apartments, traditional hallway-style bedrooms, residential colleges, and language houses provide a wide variety of experiences for undergraduate student living. Students in their final undergraduate year may apply to live on the historic Lawn at the heart of Jefferson's original university. We encourage you to investigate each option available to you as you craft your university experience.

On-Grounds housing benefits include:

Convenient locations close to classes, dining halls, and more.
Affordability, with a commitment for the nine-month academic year only.
The ability to live with friends while choosing among a range of housing style options.
Opportunities to make substantial contributions to your area and the University.

Housing Application for Incoming Transfer Students
Available housing applications for incoming transfer students are below. If a particular application is not yet open, the date on which you can apply is listed.

If you receive an error when logging into the application portal for the first time, please note that it sometimes takes 2-3 business days after you submit your enrollment deposit before you appear as a matriculated student in our system. We appreciate your patience!

Supporting Your Housing Needs
In the course of your time at UVA, a variety of special circumstances may affect your housing needs. The team at Housing & Residence Life recognizes that housing situations are not one-size-fits-all, and we want to help!

We invite you to follow the links below for additional information that you might find useful. If you have special circumstances that are not covered here, please contact us at housingassignments@virginia.edu.

Disability Housing Accommodations
Disability housing accommodations are available for students with disabilities or medical conditions that require accommodations such as wheelchair accessibility, modified safety alarms, kitchen access, a single room, a service or assistance animal, etc. All requests for accommodations are received and reviewed by the Student Disability Access Center (SDAC).

If you have any questions, please contact SDAC at 434.243.5180 or send an email to sdac@virginia.edu.

How do I apply?
Students must submit their housing application to Housing & Residence Life (HRL). In addition, students must initiate and participate in the intake and eligibility process through SDAC, which is initiated by applying for SDAC services.

In most cases, students should submit a Student Request for Housing Accommodation Form to SDAC; their treating provider also should provide documentation, such as by completing the Verification of Disability form.
Students with existing SDAC accommodations will continue to work with their assigned SDAC Advisor. Students must request housing accommodations on an annual basis.
Students must adnere to HRL's application process and deadlines (listed below), regardless of their status in the SDAC process. IF the student submits their SDAC request after the deadline, and appropriate housing is not available, the student will be placed on a priority waitlist. 

Application Deadlines for 2026-2027 Housing
Returning Undergraduates applying to live in residential colleges and language houses: October 19, 2025
Returning Undergraduates applying to live in upperclass apartments and JMW: December 1, 2025
Graduate Students: TBA
Incoming First-Year Undergraduates: June 1, 2026
Incoming Transfer Undergraduates: June 1, 2026

Undergraduate and graduate students who are married and/or have children may apply to live in Copeley Hill apartments in graduate student housing. Copeley Hill offers one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments.

How do I apply?
The application for new residents is available beginning April 1.

A random computer-generated selection process held after the priority application deadline determines your order of assignment, if housing is available. Please note that a housing offer is not guaranteed.  If space is not available on Grounds, you may want to consider off-Grounds options.

Returning graduate housing residents are given the option to renew their housing agreement for a maximum of four years. The renewal process takes place in early March. 
Application Deadlines for 2025-2026
Deadline for current residents to renew: March 3, 2025
Priority Application Deadline for new residents: April 7, 2025

Service and Assistance Animals: Students must request the University's permission to allow the presence of a service animal or assistance animal on University property. Permission will be granted only as a reasonable accommodation for a documented disability. Please see the SDAC Housing Accommodations page to learn more and request an accommodation.

All requests for service or assistance animals are received and reviewed by the Student Disability Access Center (SDAC). For more information, contact SDAC at 434.243.5180 or send an email to sdac@virginia.edu.
